Container.Name: ozbargain-hunter
Container.Overview: Personal deal and classifieds watcher for OzBargain: a Next.js web UI and a five-minute poll loop in one container, with alerts delivered by email, Matrix or ntfy.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The application's port inside the container (design 2.2). Both paths — the Cloudflare Tunnel hostname and a direct LAN request — arrive here. The application verifies the Cloudflare Access JWT on every request, so publishing the port does not expose the UI.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: ALL persistent state: the SQLite database, its WAL files and the nightly snapshot (design 10.6). Nothing of value is written inside the container. The directory must be writable by uid 1000 (the container's non-root user): chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/ozbargain-hunter

Config.Name: Deals feed URL
Config.Description: The deals feed. Polled twice per cycle, as page 0 and page 1; the application never requests page 2 (design 3.3, D41).

Config.Name: Front page feed URL
Config.Description: The front-page feed, polled once per cycle. A deal that only ever appears here is still observed and matched (D43).

Config.Name: Classifieds URL
Config.Description: The classifieds page, polled on its own longer interval. Requires the session cookie below.

Config.Name: User-Agent
Config.Description: The User-Agent every outbound request carries (design 3.8). Leave as-is: it identifies the client honestly.

Config.Name: Deals poll interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds between deal polls. 300 (five minutes) is the floor the application enforces.

Config.Name: Classifieds poll interval (seconds)
Config.Description: Seconds between classifieds polls. One hour by default (design 3.6).

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: The SQLite database. Must stay on the bind mount: the worker and the UI are separate processes that share this one file.

Config.Name: Snapshot path
Config.Description: Where the nightly snapshot is written. Must stay on the bind mount.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: The IANA time zone the container runs in, set explicitly rather than inherited from the host. The nightly snapshot and all timestamps follow it.

Config.Name: Health check secret
Config.Description: The container-local secret /healthz authenticates with (D62). Set it to a random string; the image's own health check sends it. Without it /healthz rejects every request, including the container's. Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.

Config.Name: CSRF secret
Config.Description: Signs the double-submit CSRF tokens for every state-changing request (design 8.6). Set it to a random string; an unset value denies every mutation. Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access team domain
Config.Description: The Access team host. The JWKS is fetched from it, and the token issuer must be https:// followed by this host (design 8.2).

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access audience
Config.Description: The Access application's AUD tag. Tokens are verified against it on every request.

Config.Name: Icon route public
Config.Description: Exempt the icon route from the Access check, so a notification client can render the logo without a session (O15). true or false.

Config.Name: OzBargain account cookie
Config.Description: The session cookie for the classifieds section, pasted from the UI's session screen (screen 9). Until O21 is resolved this is how the classifieds session is supplied; the application never requests /user/login. Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: SMTP host for the email provider.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: SMTP port. 0 means unset.

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: SMTP username.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: SMTP password. Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.

Config.Name: Email from
Config.Description: The From address on alert emails.

Config.Name: Email to
Config.Description: The To address on alert emails.

Config.Name: Matrix homeserver URL
Config.Description: The Matrix homeserver the matrix provider posts to.

Config.Name: Matrix access token
Config.Description: The access token for the matrix provider (O11). Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.

Config.Name: Matrix room id
Config.Description: The room alerts are posted to.

Config.Name: Matrix user id
Config.Description: The account the matrix provider posts as.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: The ntfy server the ntfy provider publishes to.

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: The ntfy access token, when the topic is protected. Intentionally empty until the Sponsor sets it in the GUI.
